records.title: Absa Graduate Programme
records.description: We offer you the opportunity to be part of this exciting growth journey.

records.title: GenA Graduate Programme
records.description: Be part of a structured development programme that will connect you to graduates from across the continent giving you the skills to be self-empowered and cross-culturally competent.

records.title: SAICA Trainee Programme
records.description: The purpose of the South African Institute of Chartered Accountants (SAICA) programme is to provide our handpicked SAICA trainees with the relevant experience and competencies.

records.title: CIMA Trainee Programme
records.description: Qualify as an efficient and competent accountant through our Chartered Institute of Management Accountants (CIMA) programme.

records.title: Absa bursary Programme
records.description: We select a handful of talented top performers and provide them with financial support to complete their education and potentially pursue a career with us.

records.title: Audit Graduate Recruitment
records.description: Whatever you aspire to, it’s all here for you. From great people, a supportive & collaborative culture, to prestigious clients and unlimited career potential.

records.title: Sustainability Reporting and Assurance Graduate Programme
records.description: This 36-month graduate programme is designed for candidates seeking to contribute to assurance and reporting advisory services.

records.title: Actuarial & Insurance Solutions Graduate Programme
records.description: As part of the AIS Graduate Programme, you will render assistance on allocated assignments under clear instruction and guidance of the Manager/Senior Manager/Partner.

records.title: Infinity X Graduate Programme
records.description: After an immersive Consulting 101 training boot camp, you’ll be exposed to a variety of Deloitte Consulting offerings or industries.

records.title: TrAX Graduate Programme
records.description: The TrAX graduate programme is a two-year fixed term contract consisting of several pathways, aimed at broadening your tax and legal knowledge, instilling and building confidence to take on new challenges, and allowing you to expand your career possibilities.

records.title: Assurance/Audit Graduate Programme
records.description: We offer three-year trainee contracts to top-calibre students who are studying towards a Chartered Accountancy qualification at a SAICA-accredited university.
records.qualifications: To pursue a career as a Chartered Accountant you will need to enrol for a Bachelor of Accounting Sciences degree or an equivalent CA(SA) undergraduate qualification at a SAICA accredited university.

records.title: The Tax Trainee Programme
records.description: Tax Trainee Programmes: SAICA (Tax Elective) and SAIT. Embark on an exciting journey with our Tax Trainee Programmes, offering experience in Finance, Tax, and Statutory Compliance.

records.title: Actuarial and Quants Graduate Programme
records.description: Join our vibrant Actuarial or Quants teams, where you'll make a meaningful technical contribution to client engagements and internal projects! Applications open from March - May each year.

records.title: Forensic and Integrity Services Graduate Programme
records.description: Applications open from April - July each year.
records.qualifications: Minimum overall academic average of 65% or above.
records.field_of_study: BCom/BCom Honours degree in Accounting/Auditing; BCom Honours degree in Forensic Accountancy; LLB; BSc Degree in Computer Science

records.title: Financial Accounting and Advisory Services (FAAS) Regulatory Graduate Programme
records.description: Applications for JHB open from June - July each year.
records.qualifications: A Bachelor of Commerce Degree or higher with a minimum overall academic average of 65%.
records.field_of_study: Economics with Risk Management; BCom with a major in Banking; Finance/Financial Sciences

records.title: Strategy and Transactions Graduate Programme
records.description: Join our Strategy and Transactions (SaT) team and be at the forefront of driving digital change. Applications open from April - July each year.
records.qualifications: A Bachelor of Commerce (BCom) degree or higher with a minimum overall academic average of 65%.
records.field_of_study: Finance; Economics; Statistics; Information Management; Actuarial Sciences

records.title: Supply Chain Graduate Programme
records.description: Join the EY Advisory Supply Chain Domain, where we tackle the complete end-to-end supply chain and operations strategy. Applications open from April - June each year.
records.qualifications: A Bachelor of Science (BSc) degree or higher with a minimum overall academic average of 65%.

records.title: Technology Consulting Graduate Programme
records.description: Step into the future with our Technology Consulting Graduate Programme, where technology is the heartbeat of business transformation. Applications open from May - July each year.

records.title: CcaSS Graduate Programme
records.description: Join our dynamic CcaSS team, where we bring together sustainability and ESG practitioners, environmental and social scientists, engineers, and financial experts. Applications open from April - June each year.
records.qualifications: An Honours degree or higher in Environmental or Social Science, with a minimum overall academic average of 65%.
records.field_of_study: Environmental or Human Rights Law; Engineering: Renewable Energy, Civil, or Chemical; Development Finance, Sustainable Development, Impact Finance, or Business Administration with a Sustainability Focus

records.title: Technology and Risk (IT Audit) Programme
records.description: Join our Technology and Risk team, where we help clients achieve sustainable growth by safeguarding their business performance. Applications for JHB and CPT open from April - June each year.
records.qualifications: A minimum overall academic average of 65% or above.
records.field_of_study: BCom in Information Systems/Science; BCom Honours in Internal Audit; BSc in Computer Science

records.title: Bursary Programme
records.description: Bursaries are awarded to individuals who we believe have the commitment to qualify as a Chartered Accountant and an academic record which indicates the ability to do so with due regard to financial need.
records.qualifications: A valid South African identity document. Studying a CA degree at a SAICA accredited university.

records.title: Apply for NSFAS funding for the 2027 academic year
